page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core. There is no local NVMe or SSD storage bundled with this instance, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A key technical characteristic of the ecs.s3.medium is its highly constrained CPU instruction set. Hardware flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), cryptography acceleration (AES, SHA), and virtualization extensions are not available on this instance. This lack of advanced instruction sets limits its capability for vector processing, cryptographic operations, and nested virtualization.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a low memory-to-CPU ratio and the absence of local storage, this instance represents a budget-conscious compute-centric profile. It is designed for workloads that require dedicated CPU execution time but do not demand large memory capacities or advanced instruction sets. Suitable workloads include basic web serving, lightweight background workers, and simple non-vectorized computational tasks.
